avoidWhen: Do not transplant government branding or infer official authority. A small practice with two services may not need a huge directory or search control.

lessons: Unify diverse content with one restrained framing rule while allowing distinct spans and proportions.
Let an interior become a decision/reading tool; carry visual identity through typography and navigation rather than repeating the homepage board.
useWhen: An established graphic voice and multiple useful campaign/product materials exist
Visitors browse heterogeneous editorial content then need detailed answers
avoidWhen: Sparse factual service brief lacks art-directed assets
Brand rhetoric would be copied as customer facts
Nested scroll and motion are unnecessary for the visitor task

records.lowComplexityAlternative: Use an ordinary vertical project index with one image, title, location and supported scope per entry; retain visible discipline navigation.

structure.opening: Rock landscape with centered inset material square and giant mixed italic/roman serif wordmark; narrow omits inset square and reduces name.
structure.navigation: Wide small uppercase topic links above opening, then persistent cream wordmark/navigation strip; narrow hamburger and wordmark.
sequence: large serif practice statement with short right-column explanation and About/Team outlined links
same material video poster with play/consent interface

structure.evidence: Defined service descriptions and legal/contact facts on home; actual work portraits, credited testimonial, practice experience disclosures and specialist contacts on service interior.
structure.density: Large statements/material atmosphere change into modest explanatory copy, service disclosures and practical footer; interior adds substantive proof rather than repeating home.
structure.imageTypeRelationship: Large serif statements, small italic section labels and slim sans explanations/controls separate roles. Material metaphor is distinct from work/team proof.
structure.interior: Commercial Arbitration begins with section label, large serif proposition and small supporting paragraph. Moving mixed-type slogan leads to experience categories, unequal work portraits, attributed quote and four key contacts with portrait/name/role/location/contact icons; adjacent service links and common footer end it.
structure.responsive: Home large statement and secondary explanation stack; buttons retain side-by-side. Footer becomes two utility columns then full-width form. Interior initially retained wide line wrapping after viewport resize; fresh narrow navigation corrected meaningful headings. Two work portraits become overlapped unequal scales, key contacts become two-column grid, adjacent services stack.
structure.action: Commercial Arbitration disclosure actually expanded with readable explanation/Find Out More at both sizes; service route then opened from observed href. Narrow States and State Entities experience disclosure expanded explanatory case narrative; no form/contact/video submitted or played.

observedRelationships: Material metaphor introduces identity while small explanatory prose identifies the practice and its task.
Home service disclosure adds a brief explanation and relevant route in place; interior develops it into experience categories, documentary work and specialists.
Unequal work portraits and a attributed quotation differ from the compact structured contact grid.
Narrow footer preserves useful utility groups then makes the contact form full-width.
lessons: Use original cleared material imagery only where actual positioning supports it.
Explain the service clearly alongside atmospheric identity, with supported expertise facts.
Develop service interiors into actual experience/process and relevant specialists.
Make disclosures semantic, preserve visible controls and static readable primary copy; avoid requiring scroll animation for essential text.
useWhen: A professional practice has an authentic body of work and a clear service scope.
avoidWhen: Do not transfer publisher projects, branding, claims, imagery, or ornamental motion.
Existing direction already overuses warm paper, oversized display type and ruled service lists.
records.adds: Restrained professional material identity with genuine home-to-service depth, actual both-size service disclosure and documentary work/specialist proof; narrow resize defect recorded.

records.lowComplexityAlternative: Use an ordinary linked topic index and a readable article with clear return and next-topic controls; video can be optional.

structure.density: Large index words and broad spacing change to continuous serif article reading with small sans labels.

structure.interior: Desktop article separates title/video on left from explanatory prose/questions on right with central rule; mobile title/video precede the full prose.
structure.responsive: Topics reduce scale while preserving centered list; article columns become one coherent reading column with return above and next-topic below.
structure.action: Choose an everyday topic, read, then continue to another topic or return; updates form observed without submission.

observedRelationships: The opening is a subject index rather than a claim-plus-image hero.
Condensed topic labels and serif explanatory prose serve distinct task and reading roles.
Desktop parallel media/prose becomes title, optional video, introduction, sections and questions on mobile.
lessons: Use the vocabulary visitors recognize as the main way into a dense information collection.
Differentiate navigation type from reading type without adding decorative cards.
Make embedded media optional; preserve the written reading path and return/next links.

avoidWhen: Do not copy legal assertions into customer facts; record design relationships only.
